text: What if you did ten sets of scapular push-ups every day?
This small move trains the serratus anterior, the muscle on the side of your ribs.
It holds your shoulder blades flat on your back, and keeps your shoulders healthy when you push or press.
Get into a plank, arms locked straight.
Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades, then push the floor away. Only the blades move.
After thirty days, less shoulder blade winging, a steadier push-up, and stronger, safer presses.
